errors.text_span: Distribution of the number of specialists in the field of tourism in the city of Samara in 2019.
errors.evidence: The chart represents data about the level of preparation and qualification of specialists for Passive House projects, not tourism in Samara.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart illustrates the level of preparation and qualification of specialists for Passive House projects.
The description does not mention the presence of four sectors, their colors (blue, red, purple, green), or the percentages (3%, 23%, 23%, 51%) displayed within the sectors.
The description does not mention the legend on the right side of the chart, which provides detailed labels for each sector.
